# ASR fixtures

`commons-audio-cc0.wav` is a 2.4-second spoken WAV downloaded from
[Wikimedia Commons: Audio.wav](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Audio.wav).
The uploader dedicates it to CC0-1.0. Its SHA-256 is
`8640a316bbbd623fc678252dcc797165c8606a4643f5834cd8f03456d2cbc72e`.

It is intentionally small and is used only to exercise local capture framing,
native-stream transport, and batch-transcription contracts. It is not a quality
or language-coverage benchmark corpus.
